question:
Which numbers should come in place of the two question marks '?' in the same sequence to make the series logically complete?

2, 3, 5, 8, 13, ?, 34, ?
solution:
The logic followed here is:

Logic: **Each term of the series is the sum of its two previous terms.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1920f98e9196ec5e2159cea0db25546cb39e249cde5a6eea1fdcc97d7185b4fc.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is **"****21, 55"**.
